task.description:
Task: cs-mail-workflow-handoff-consent-guard-fd001-alignment.
Use existing worker-1 mail worktree /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker1-mail-context-20260520T115222Z after completed task 29 commit 8821ed69. This lane is disjoint from worker-2 messenger runtime-binding work and worker-3 ontology.
Scope: crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs plus exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-mail-workflow-handoff-consent-guard-fd001-alignment-* and evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-workflow-handoff-consent-guard-fd001-alignment.json only. No root manifests, contracts, registries, adapters, async workflow clients, Cedar policy files, or docs.
Before editing read authority/context: specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, microservices/mail/IP-013-mail-workflow-handoff.md, microservices/mail/capabilities/T1-assist.yaml, microservices/mail/policy/dual-context-isolation.md DCI-06, current crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs including StrictMailContextBoundaryGuard and StrictMailLegalHoldApprovalGuard, and one similar pure guard/state-machine pattern in the repo. Run planning-closure start gate. Claim with Oya VCS as worker-1 intent "FD001 mail workflow handoff consent guard" for crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs::MailWorkflowHandoffGuard.
Implement a pure zero-I/O domain primitive for mail-to-Workflow handoff consent/audit readiness: request model includes requester context, mailbox/source context, source_message_id, extracted_payload_digest, optional workflow_item_id, consent basis (explicit user action session id OR tenant policy basis ref), requested_at_epoch_seconds; Personal-pillar source is refused; requester and source must share tenant-governed boundary; consent basis must be present and non-empty; extracted payload digest/source message/workflow item fields must be non-empty; output/receipt/event model should deterministically represent MailWorkflowHandoffCreated with source message id, workflow item id, consent basis summary, extracted payload digest, requested_at_epoch_seconds, and audit event kind label. Add deterministic MailError variants for invalid handoff fields and missing/invalid consent. Keep business logic in domain; no handlers/adapters/I/O.
Tests: Professional explicit-user consent succeeds; Shared tenant-policy consent succeeds; Personal-pillar source refused; cross-context refused before consent; missing consent refused; empty session/basis refused; empty digest refused; empty workflow item refused; generated event contains source_message_id/workflow_item_id/digest/consent basis/audit label. Preserve existing 39 mail tests.
Verify: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain -- --nocapture; cargo nextest run -p oya-connect-mail-domain; cargo clippy -p oya-connect-mail-domain --all-targets -- -D warnings; planning-closure; data-class; architecture-boundaries; catalog; dependency-seam; oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote. Commit only scoped lib/evidence with Lore trailers.
